subject.title: Feishu: @mention not recognized in group when multiple bots share the same group (open_id app-scoped mismatch)

question: Which Feishu bot identity strategy should become canonical for multi-bot group @mention admission when Feishu open_id values are app-scoped?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the active union_id PR depends on an identity source the reporter says bot/v3/info does not provide, so automation should not choose the permanent Feishu identity contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Prove And Land Stable Identity
options.body: Resolve or replace the open PR around a verified Feishu identity source, cover all mention parsing paths, and require live multi-bot proof before merge.

options.title: Document Platform Limitation
options.body: If Feishu exposes no reliable cross-app bot identity, keep requireMention conservative and document the supported multi-bot workaround.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Identity Work
options.body: Defer this issue only if maintainers want one design covering mention identity, bot-to-bot visibility, and session/account scope together.

recommendation.title: Prove And Land Stable Identity
recommendation.body: Resolve or replace the open PR around a verified Feishu identity source, cover all mention parsing paths, and require live multi-bot proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are already reviewing the linked implementation PR and called out the Feishu identity surface as a non-mechanical current-main rewrite decision.
